sourceData.meaningMnemonic: In a <radical>yurt</radical> you use a <radical>towel</radical> as a <kanji>seat</kanji>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: Something about using a towel for a <kanji>seat</kanji> is very <reading>sexy</reading> (<ja>せき</ja>) to you. Probably because you associate it with sexy people using towel seats on the beach.
sourceData.meaningInfo: Picture this yurt, with towels laid out as seats for everyone who visits.
sourceData.readingInfo: Imagine the sexiest person you've ever seen, using a towel as a seat next to you in this yurt. Maybe they're in a bathing suit. Maybe they're completely covered up. Either way, they're very sexy.
